hero_intro: Classic and Italian cookies, creamy cheesecakes and cozy loaves, baked to order in my Richmond Hill kitchen. Made fresh for your holidays, showers, gatherings and ordinary Tuesdays.
about: I bake everything myself, in small batches, with real butter and no shortcuts. Every order is made for you, so it's never sitting on a shelf. Thank you for supporting a local small business.
menu_intro: Everything is baked fresh for your pickup date. Flavours change with the seasons, so follow along on Instagram for what's new.
menu_note: Prices in CAD. Custom designs are quoted after you order. Gluten-free and egg-free options may be available on request; ask in your order notes.

announcement.text: Holiday Cookie Boxes: only 30 this year · orders close Dec 12

request_title: Craving something not on the menu?
request_intro: Tell me what you have in mind, whether it's a family recipe, a regional Italian treat or a dessert for a special event. I'll let you know if I can make it and send you a quote.
